title: Grade 1 Math — Addition and Subtraction Stories
subject: Math
description: Practice with questions on join, compare, missing part, equations.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: Kai has 6 pencils. He gets 7 more. How many pencils now?
Nine ducks are in a pond. Four swim away. How many remain?
Nia has 12 shells. Ada has 8. How many more shells does Nia have?
Luz has 9 cards. She wants 15. How many more cards does she need?
There are 8 green beads and 5 white beads. How many beads are there?
A tray had 11 cups. Now it has 7. How many were taken?
There are 14 hooks and 12 coats. Each coat gets a hook. How many hooks are empty?
Ben makes 5 paper boats. Jo makes 6. How many boats did they make in all?
Rae puts some books on a shelf. Then she adds 4, making 10. How many went on the shelf first?
Mika has 10 cubes. Dev has 3 more than Mika. How many cubes does Dev have?
The basket holds 17 apples. Six are red and the rest are green. How many are green?
A game starts with 16 tiles on a rug. Players move 9 off the rug. How many stay on it?
Twelve seats are taken. Three seats are empty. How many seats are there in all?
Jin has 4 more stickers than Lee, who has 6. How many does Jin have?
A team earns 5 points, then 3, then 2. How many points in all?
There are 15 chairs. Five are blue and four are green. The rest are brown. How many are brown?
Ana is on step 14. She walks down 6 steps. What step is she on?
A bag has 7 round buttons and 7 square buttons. How many buttons are in it?
A child has 18 blocks and wants to give away enough to keep 10. How many should the child give away?
At the park, 6 children are on swings and 5 are on the slide. Then 2 more join the slide. How many children are there now?
